name: Question 3
problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,P\,$ | $\,Q\,$ | $\,P⇒(¬P∨¬Q)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
worked_solution:
First, we add columns for $¬P,$ $¬Q$ and $¬P∨¬Q:$

| $\,P\,$ | $\,Q\,$ | $\,¬P\,$ | $\,¬Q\,$ | $\,¬P∨¬Q\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Now, we add a column for $P⇒(¬P∨¬Q).$ This statement is true unless $P$ is true and $¬P∨¬Q$ is false. 

| $\,P\,$ | $\,Q\,$ | $\,¬P\,$ | $\,¬Q\,$ | $\,¬P∨¬Q\,$ | $\,P⇒(¬P∨¬Q)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
